_notes: poi.city is the hub city used for clustering and intercity legs (Mysuru includes Srirangapatna; Chikmagalur includes Belur/Halebidu; Coorg covers Kodagu). Locality lives in the name/tags. Fees and hours are from Rohan's/Claude's knowledge and are estimates unless trust=verified. Edges reference POIs by name (globally unique). Intercity legs are listed once; seed.py inserts both directions.

pois.name: Mysore Palace
pois.best_time: Sunday and public-holiday evenings for the illumination (19:00-19:45)
pois.accessibility_notes: Ramps at the entrance; footwear removed inside; long queues on weekends

pois.name: Mysore Zoo (Sri Chamarajendra Zoological Gardens)
pois.accessibility_notes: 2-3 km walking loop; battery vehicles for hire; Rs 150 weekdays / Rs 180 weekends (estimated)

pois.name: Somanathapura Chennakesava Temple
